authorization: The user's relayed request to repeat the review as needed. The coordinator assigned explicit routes Claude Opus 5.5 for correctness and Grok 4.7 for Russian comprehensibility to execute that request; this is not a standing model override.
limits: Actual families come from configuration, every tool dispatch, every response and every usage record, not from launch labels.

The Claude reviewer's context was compacted twice by the same model. Its report says it re-extracted the examples it relied on; complete contiguous returns before compaction document exposure, not retention.
Coverage uses successful tool result.content returns. A complete contiguous return documents exposure, not comprehension; a null returnedRange is reported as such.
Reviewer outputs are separate originals. No report, finding or author rationale was shared between them.
No learner fixes, rechecks, acceptance gates, ledger promotion, publication, pin change or next batch. Not device, media, voice, drawing or activation clearance.

candidateExport.method: git ls-tree -r + git cat-file --batch raw blobs; every exported file re-hashed to its Git blob ID

reviewInputs.note: The unchanged candidate tree and common packet were exported outside the author worktree and session state so that reviewers could read them without access to author records.

blindnessAudit.method: Tool-call arguments other than the final stdout echo searched for the RU worktree, session state, batch records, ledger, tracking and progress paths.

reviews.hashDomains: Report body hash covers the exact final response UTF-8 string, not stdout wrappers. Logged content hashes cover successful tool result.content UTF-8 strings, not network bytes. Only public report and evidence metadata are exported; no private prompts or reasoning.
